messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide Inc announces expansion to 50 new cities. Millfield is listed for Phase 2 deployment, expected in 2 months.

Business closing: Carlos Ruiz — after the meeting — tonight, at the kitchen table, after the kids are in bed — open the browser tab again. this time don't close it. look specifically at ev and hybrid certification programs: what they cost, how long they take, whether his existing ase certifications carry over, and whether any shops in a 40-mile radius are already hiring for ev-specific work.

You Spend extended time on the floor during lunch service actively listening to what the Auto Row workers know and believe about the RoboRide timeline, the Phase 2 rollout, and what the bosses are saying. Ask careful, genuine questions — not as market research but as a neighbor who wants to understand. Record notes in the back after close.. Savings grew by $116.
